summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727 KB payload
details: The package declares `scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"`. On `npm install`, `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a single-line 727 KB file bearing obfuscator.io fingerprints (rotated string-array shuffled by function `WV8StW` over `n7gIxM`, `_0x`-style hex-renamed identifiers, dense hex constants and char-code lookups). The package is advertised as a shared React components library and has no build-time need for a second JavaScript runtime or an opaque half-megabyte payload. Executing the payload via a freshly downloaded alternate runtime bypasses Node-resolved static analysis and hides the code that actually runs on the installer's host at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
